details: For every fixed integer $k\geq0$ and every class over a nonempty domain, $\mathrm L^{\mathrm{mist}}_k(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm L(\mathcal H)+k$. This strengthens the non-affine comparison recorded separately.
proof: Start with any ordinary shattered tree of minimum branch length d. Below each leaf attach a complete binary tree of depth k, using a fixed domain point (available because the domain is nonempty) at all added internal nodes. The hypothesis realizing the original branch disagrees with at most k of the added labels, so the resulting tree is k-shattered and has minimum branch length d+k. Take the supremum over d.
proof_source: The $k$-shattered-tree definition in Section 2.2.1 of \cite{filmus2023randomized}; the extension argument is direct.
name: $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension / Littlestone Dimension (affine)
